comment: Whether product URLs include their category path.
modal: When **Yes**, a product reachable under a category gets a URL that includes the category path (e.g. `/gear/bags/product`). Affects URL structure and canonicalisation.

comment: Whether a permanent (301) redirect is created when a product or category URL key changes.
modal: When **Yes**, changing a URL key leaves behind a permanent redirect from the old URL, so existing links and search rankings are preserved.
